topics.title: Sets and Inequalities
topics.scope: Sets: notation, subsets, union, intersection, complement, Venn diagrams; necessary and sufficient conditions, simple quantifiers; properties of inequalities; linear, quadratic, rational (fractional) and absolute-value inequalities; AM-GM for simple maxima/minima.

topics.title: Functions, Exponents and Logarithms
topics.scope: Function concept, domain, range, composition, inverse functions; monotonicity, odd/even, periodicity, graph transformations; linear and quadratic functions; power, exponential and logarithmic functions and their laws; solving exponential and log equations; piecewise functions; zeros of functions.

topics.title: Trigonometry
topics.scope: Radians, unit-circle definitions, special angle values, signs by quadrant; identities, induction (reduction) formulas, sum and difference, double angle; graphs of sin, cos, tan, y = A sin(ωx + φ), period, amplitude, phase; solving triangles with the sine and cosine rules, triangle area.

topics.title: Sequences
topics.scope: General term, recursive definitions; arithmetic sequences (nth term, sum, mean); geometric sequences (nth term, sum, infinite sum with |r| < 1); mixed and telescoping sums.

topics.title: Derivatives and Their Applications
topics.scope: Definition and geometric meaning of the derivative; derivatives of basic functions; sum, product, quotient and simple chain rules; tangent lines; increasing/decreasing intervals, extrema, maximum and minimum on an interval; simple optimisation.

topics.title: Analytic Geometry: Lines, Circles and Conics
topics.scope: Slope, inclination, equations of lines, parallel and perpendicular, distance from a point to a line; circles (standard and general form, line-circle and circle-circle position); ellipse, hyperbola, parabola: standard equations, foci, eccentricity, asymptotes, directrix, simple chord problems.

topics.title: Vectors and Complex Numbers
topics.scope: Plane vectors: addition, scalar multiples, coordinates, dot product, angle, length, parallel and perpendicular conditions; complex numbers: i, algebraic form, arithmetic, conjugate, modulus, the complex plane.

topics.title: Solid Geometry
topics.scope: Prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones, spheres: surface area and volume; lines and planes in space (parallel, perpendicular); 3-D rectangular coordinates, distance between points, midpoints; simple angles in solids.

topics.title: Probability and Statistics
topics.scope: Counting basics (multiplication principle, simple permutations and combinations); classical probability, complementary and independent events; mean, median, mode, variance and standard deviation; reading frequency tables; normal distribution basics (symmetry, μ ± σ ideas).

topics.title: Kinematics
topics.scope: Displacement, velocity, acceleration; uniform and uniformly accelerated motion equations; free fall, vertical throw; motion graphs (x-t, v-t); projectile motion; relative motion basics.

topics.title: Forces and Newton's Laws
topics.scope: Gravity, normal force, friction (static/kinetic), tension, springs (Hooke's law); force resolution and equilibrium; Newton's three laws; inclines, connected bodies, pulleys, apparent weight in lifts.

topics.title: Momentum and Impulse
topics.scope: Momentum, impulse-momentum theorem, conservation of momentum, elastic and inelastic collisions, recoil, explosions.

topics.title: Work, Energy and Power
topics.scope: Work, power, kinetic energy, work-energy theorem, gravitational and elastic potential energy, conservation of mechanical energy, efficiency, energy with friction.

topics.title: Circular Motion and Gravitation
topics.scope: Angular velocity, period, centripetal acceleration and force; vertical circles, banked curves; Newton's law of gravitation, g at altitude, satellite orbits, orbital speed and period, Kepler's third law.

topics.title: Oscillations and Waves
topics.scope: Simple harmonic motion, spring and simple pendulum periods, energy in SHM; transverse and longitudinal waves, v = fλ, wave graphs, reflection, superposition, standing waves, sound, Doppler effect (qualitative).

topics.title: Electrostatics
topics.scope: Charge, Coulomb's law, electric field strength and field lines, potential and potential difference, work done on charges, capacitors (C = Q/U, parallel plate), motion of charges in uniform fields.

topics.title: DC Circuits
topics.scope: Current, resistance, resistivity, Ohm's law, series and parallel, EMF and internal resistance, electrical power and energy, meters, simple circuit analysis.

topics.title: Magnetic Fields
topics.scope: Magnetic field and field lines, field of currents (right-hand rule), force on a current-carrying wire (F = BIL), Lorentz force, circular motion of charges in a magnetic field.

topics.title: Electromagnetic Induction and AC
topics.scope: Magnetic flux, Faraday's law, Lenz's law, motional EMF (E = BLv), self-induction basics, alternating current, rms values, ideal transformers.

topics.title: Thermal Physics
topics.scope: Molecular kinetic theory, temperature and internal energy, ideal gas law and gas laws, specific heat and latent heat, first law of thermodynamics, second law (qualitative).

topics.title: Optics
topics.scope: Reflection, refraction, refractive index, Snell's law, total internal reflection and critical angle, lenses and mirrors (basic), dispersion; interference (double slit), diffraction, polarisation.

topics.title: Modern Physics
topics.scope: Photoelectric effect and photon energy, wave-particle duality, Bohr model and energy levels, spectra, nuclear structure, radioactivity (alpha, beta, gamma), half-life, nuclear equations, mass-energy, fission and fusion.

topics.title: Matter, Chemical Language and Equations
topics.scope: Classification of matter (elements, compounds, mixtures, pure substances), physical vs chemical change, states of matter, formulas and valency, naming, balancing equations, reaction types, colloids.

topics.title: The Mole and Calculations
topics.scope: Relative atomic and molecular mass, the mole, Avogadro constant, molar mass, molar volume of gases, ideal gas equation, solution concentration (mol/L, mass fraction), dilution, reaction stoichiometry, limiting reagent, yield.

topics.title: Inorganic Elements and Compounds
topics.scope: Properties and reactions of Na, Mg, Al, Fe, Cu and their compounds; non-metals Cl, S, N, C, Si and their oxides and acids; common acids, bases and salts; amphoteric behaviour; everyday and environmental chemistry.

topics.title: Organic Chemistry
topics.scope: Alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, benzene; functional groups (alcohols, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, esters); isomerism; naming simple compounds; substitution, addition, elimination, esterification, polymerisation; basic biomolecules (sugars, proteins, fats).

topics.title: Redox Reactions
topics.scope: Oxidation states, oxidation and reduction, oxidising and reducing agents, electron transfer, balancing redox equations, galvanic cells and electrolysis basics.

topics.title: Ionic Reactions and Tests for Ions
topics.scope: Electrolytes, ionic equations, conditions for ionic reactions, ion coexistence in solution, tests for common cations and anions (Cl⁻, SO₄²⁻, CO₃²⁻, NH₄⁺, Fe³⁺, Fe²⁺).

topics.title: Atomic Structure and the Periodic Table
topics.scope: Protons, neutrons, electrons, isotopes, electron configuration (first 20 elements and simple transition cases), periodic trends (radius, ionisation energy, electronegativity, metallic character), groups and periods.

topics.title: Chemical Bonding and Structure
topics.scope: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonds, electron-dot structures, polarity, molecular shapes (VSEPR basics), intermolecular forces and hydrogen bonding, crystal types and their properties.

topics.title: Reaction Rates and Equilibrium
topics.scope: Factors affecting rate, activation energy and catalysts, reversible reactions, dynamic equilibrium, Le Chatelier's principle, equilibrium constant expressions, energy changes (exothermic/endothermic, ΔH).

topics.title: Acids, Bases and Electrolyte Solutions
topics.scope: Acid-base theories, strong and weak electrolytes, pH and its calculation for simple cases, neutralisation, hydrolysis of salts, buffers (qualitative), titration basics.

topics.title: Laboratory Work and Industrial Chemistry
topics.scope: Lab safety, common apparatus, preparing and collecting gases (O₂, H₂, CO₂, NH₃, Cl₂), separation and purification (filtration, distillation, crystallisation, extraction), identifying substances, industrial processes (Haber process, contact process, metal extraction).
